g.title: HGS
g.text: HGS — Hybrid Genetic Search (Vidal 2022, Algorithm 1) with VRPP adaptations

Giant-tour genotype decoded by a profit-aware Linear Split; dual feasible / infeasible sub-populations; RP-GPX crossover; education by granular local search (SWAP*, 2-opt*, relocate…); biased fitness = profit rank + diversity rank; adaptive capacity penalty. Objective: maximise profit = R·Σ waste − C·Σ distance.

g.title: a_params
g.text: Load capacity, R, C · sub-problem (all bins if vrpp)
HGSParams: time_limit 60 s, restart_timer, μ=25, λ=40 offspring,

g.title: a_map
g.text: map local routes → global tour · km on full matrix

g.title: a_solve
g.text: HGSSolver(dist, wastes, capacity, R, C, params,

g.title: i_split
g.text: LinearSplit(dist, wastes, capacity, R, C, mandatory, max_vehicles)
O(n) Bellman split with profit objective (see 5.)

g.title: i_ls
g.text: moves: relocate · swap · SWAP* · 2-opt · 2-opt* · Or-opt · cross

g.title: m_pop
g.text: insert into feasible / infeasible sub-population by capacity violation

g.title: m_best0
g.text: best = max profit in feasible pop (or none)

g.title: m_ret
g.text: or best of both pops if no feasible found

g.title: o_par
g.text: PARENT SELECTION: two binary tournaments over the union
of both sub-populations (lower biased fitness wins)

g.title: n_ins
g.text: insert child into feasible or infeasible sub-population
(by its own capacity violation) · record offspring signals

g.title: m_trim
g.text: update biased fitness; repeatedly remove a clone

g.title: f_rank
g.text: rank_diversity: mean broken-pairs distance to nb_close nearest (desc)
fitness = rank_profit + (1 − nb_elite / |pop|) · rank_diversity (lower is better)

g.title: m_pen
g.text: VRPP: offspring coverage & profit margin signals → ×0.85 / ×1.2 / ×√1.2,

g.title: o_gpx
g.text: physical edges of p1 ∪ p2 → uncommon-edge components →
inherit best component per partition → pack remaining nodes

g.title: o_eval1
g.text: profit, cost, revenue, capacity violation, penalised cost

g.title: o_ls
g.text: first-improvement over granular (u, v) pairs until no move improves
penalised profit; may insert unvisited profitable nodes or drop unprofitable ones;
giant tour rebuilt with unvisited nodes interleaved proportionally

g.title: s_active
g.text: active sequence = giant-tour order restricted to nodes
in current routes (or, first time, nodes with R·w ≥ C·(d₀ᵢ + dᵢ₀) or mandatory)

g.title: n_rep
g.text: REPAIR: re-evaluate with penalty × 10 → LS educate →
re-evaluate with normal penalty → insert repaired copy

g.title: s_dp
g.text: prefix sums of load, revenue, distance
else limited split (k-vehicle DP) · fallback greedy split if infeasible

g.title: s_out
g.text: routes, profit → cost, revenue, capacity violation,
is_feasible, penalised cost = cost + penalty · violation
